 I don’t know about you, but I’ve been religious about my skincare routine recently. Part of it is because my 30th birthday is just a few months away, and I will have flawless skin by the time it comes around. The other part is my recently unearthed obsession with K-Beauty products, especially the brand Medicube .
 ​You’ve likely seen the brand on your TikTok “For You” page, whether for its viral Booster Pro device, which has multiple settings to help your skincare penetrate deeper, or its capsule creams, which have beads of active ingredients suspended in a gel that, when combined, create a traditional moisturizer . It’s been an easy brand to help me ease into the world of Korean skincare products , and that is why I am so excited to tell you that Medicube’s early Black Friday and Cyber Monday sales are really damn good.
 ​Starting November 19 and running through the 30th, you can save on tools, skincare, and devices, with some discounts as high as 60 percent off. If there’s ever been a time to buy your wishlist items from the brand, it's now, and I’d do it sooner rather than later so the products you’re eyeing don’t sell out.
 ​That said, I know not everyone gets the thrill of shopping as I do, so I’ve created a wishlist for you with products I think pretty much anyone would enjoy from the brand. Think of me as your personal beauty fairy guiding you through what feels like the endless products on sale from Medicube right now. Rest assured, I won’t steer you wrong.

The Booster Pro X2 is the second generation of this device, and it now has seven modes, including one that can help your sheet masks absorb better into the skin. The mode you use depends on the effect you\u2019re looking for, but if you want to sculpt, firm, target uneven texture , or even use two modes at once, this all-in-one product can target almost any concern. Review : \u201cI really liked my Booster Mini and used it regularly, but the Medicube Booster Pro X2 is in a completely different league. There are several modes to play with depending on what I\u2019m doing with my skincare, and I really like being able to adjust the intensity rather than having a one-size-fits-all experience. I\u2019ve especially enjoyed using it with my regular skincare routine.  Beauty Writer 
 Ariel Wilson is the Beauty Writer at Marie Claire. Previously the associate beauty editor at PS, she also has bylines in InStyle, Forbes Vetted, Women's Health, and more. 
 Shaped by her experience in research, social sciences, and the non-profit sector, Ariel enjoys looking at beauty from a sociocultural lens, looking to avenues like politics, culture, and the arts, to inform her views on the space. That being said, as a true beauty-product obsessive, testing the latest items to hit the market, keeping up with trends, and meeting industry icons, will always be her favorite part of working in the beauty space. 
 When she's not working, Ariel can be found hanging out with her husband and loving on their two cat daughters: Cow and Chicken.
